none: PAS FindID 1004005: Roman nummus of the House of Constantine, possibly a contemporary copy
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ D N [...] VS [...] ; R/ FEL TEMP RE-[PARATIO]

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of the House of Constantine, possibly a contemporary copy, dating to the period c.AD 355-361 (Reece period 18). Possibly FEL TEMP REPARATIO reverse type depicting a Solider spearing a fallen horseman. Unclear mint. Obverse description: Diademed, draped, and curiassed bust right. Obverse inscription: D N [...] VS [...]. Reverse description: Solider spearing a fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: FEL TEMP RE-[PARATIO]. Diameter: 21.60 mm; Thickness: 1.97 mm; Weight: 3.76g; DA:6
